summary_markdown:
The participants discussed the effort required to complete several analytical tasks. It was estimated that the first two tasks would take about one day of work, rather than 16 hours (two days).

Regarding the fifth task, it involves checking if agencies and JIC can select from ten inventory packages created by a publisher, which requires verifying access rights. This functionality reportedly worked during tests in Brazil.
decisions: The first two tasks are estimated to take one day of work.
action_items: Check if agencies/JIC can select from the publisher's 10 inventory packages.
